A fire-drake breed — heavy obsidian-black scales cracked with glowing molten-orange seams, a crown of charred back-swept horns, smoke curling from its nostrils, wing-membranes lit deep red from within, embers drifting off its muscular four-legged frame.

A frost-dragon breed — pale ice-blue armored scales rimed with frost, a row of translucent crystalline spines down its spine, curved white horns, breath fogging the air, a thick four-legged body dusted with perpetual snow.

A forest/moss-dragon breed — bark-textured green-brown scales overgrown with living moss and tiny vines, branching antler-like horns, leaf-litter caught in its hide, a sturdy four-legged body, amber eyes gleaming deep within a mossy brow.

A storm-dragon breed — slate-grey armored scales crackling with veins of caught lightning, jagged forked horns like split timber, arcs of electricity jumping between its wing-spines, a heavy four-legged frame wreathed in churning stormcloud vapour.

A volcanic dragon breed — rough cooling-lava hide of charcoal-grey and dull orange, squat blunt horns crusted with ash, shed embers trailing its four-legged bulk, fissures along its flanks pulsing cherry-red, sulfurous steam venting from its nostrils.

A crystalline dragon breed — translucent gemstone-blue scales refracting prismatic light into scattered rainbows, tall sharp faceted horns like cut quartz, four-legged body gleaming as though carved from a single enormous crystal, inner light pulsing faintly within.

A shadow-dragon breed — void-black scales that seem to absorb all light, wisps of dark smoke perpetually coiling off its four-legged body, swept-back obsidian horns barely visible in the darkness, wing-membranes like tears in the fabric of night.

A bone/death dragon breed — pale bleached-white armored plates over exposed rib-like protrusions, long curved ivory horns, hollow eye-sockets glowing with cold green witchfire, a gaunt yet powerfully built four-legged frame draped in tattered membrane wings.

A gold dragon breed — gleaming warm-gold metallic scales layered like hammered coins, swept elegant horns burnished to mirror brightness, four-legged body radiating a faint noble radiance, wing undersides shimmering copper-amber in any light source nearby.

A swamp-dragon breed — mottled dark-green and brown algae-slick scales, low flat horns crusted with river-moss, a broad heavy four-legged body trailing duckweed and mud, bioluminescent patches glowing sickly yellow-green beneath its throat and belly.

A desert-dragon breed — sandstone-tan scales textured like cracked earth, sun-bleached ridged horns curving forward, a lean yet densely muscled four-legged body shedding fine dust with every step, heat-shimmer rising visibly off its sun-baked dorsal plates.

A deep-sea dragon breed — deep-blue fin-frilled scales edged with bioluminescent teal, long swept-back finned horns, a sleek yet powerfully four-legged body trailing ghostly glowing tendrils, abyssal darkness pooling in the hollows of its enormous scaled hide.

A copper dragon breed — burnished reddish-copper scales patinated with green-blue oxidation in the crevices, spiraling ram-like horns, a stocky four-legged body gleaming warmly in sunlight, wing-membranes veined with delicate copper-green tracery like aged metalwork.

A thundercloud dragon breed — soft misty pearl-grey hide of overlapping cloud-like scale-plates, broad blunt horn nubs lost in vaporous mane, a massive four-legged body half-dissolved in rolling fog, distant thunder rumbling from deep within its barrel chest.

A bronze dragon breed — deep warm bronze-brown metallic scales etched with natural geometric striations, long swept-back horns with a subtle spiral, four-legged body dense and imposing, wing-membranes the colour of aged bronze darkening toward the trailing edges.

A magma-sea dragon breed — overlapping scales of cooled basalt black and molten amber, short thick blunt horns glowing at their bases, four-legged bulk low and wide like cooled lava flows, rivers of orange fire visible beneath translucent belly plates.

A tundra/permafrost dragon breed — heavy grey-white scales crusted with embedded ice shards, enormous curving walrus-like horn swept outward from a broad skull, four-legged body wrapped in a dense frost-rimed hide, frozen breath crystallizing instantly in the arctic air.

A jungle/poison dragon breed — vivid emerald and toxic-yellow banded scales slick with secreted venom, curved ribbed horns streaked with iridescent purple, a wide four-legged body low to the ground, toxic mist seeping between its scales in drifting coils.

A cave/obsidian dragon breed — smooth jet-black obsidian-glass scales without a single crack, short flat blade-like horns, a compact powerfully built four-legged body that reflects torchlight in sharp glints, eyes like polished silver discs catching every flicker of light.

A celestial/starlight dragon breed — deep midnight-blue scales dusted with scattered silver points like a star map, tall slender luminous horns faintly glowing, four-legged body radiating cold silver radiance, wing-membranes dark as the void but scattered with inner light.

A rust/iron dragon breed — dull reddish-brown iron-textured scales flaking at the edges like corroded metal, thick squared-off blunt horns, a massively built four-legged frame trailing rust-dust, veins of exposed dark iron visible beneath cracked scale-plates along its sides.

A plague/fungal dragon breed — dull mottled grey-green scales colonized by bioluminescent mushroom growths, gnarled twisted horns sprouting shelf-fungus, a bloated four-legged body venting clouds of glowing spores with every lumbering step and each exhaled breath.

A coral/reef dragon breed — bright pink-orange and cream calcareous scales textured like living coral, branching staghorn-coral horns, a dense four-legged body encrusted with barnacles and anemones, bioluminescent frills along its jawline flickering rhythmically like deep-reef organisms.

A silver dragon breed — bright polished-silver scales shading to cool blue-white at the belly, elegant long straight horns with faint helical ridging, a noble broad-shouldered four-legged build, wing-membranes thin as hammered foil catching every light source brilliantly.

A petrified/stone dragon breed — rough granite-grey scales indistinguishable from carved rock, stubby weathered horns encrusted with lichen, a colossal four-legged body moving with seismic weight, cracks across its hide revealing a faint molten-amber glow deep beneath the stone.
